reviews.comment: Poor teaching style, unclear explanations, and an unnecessarily rude attitude make it difficult to understand the material or engage effectively.
Honestly, pretty good experience. While Dr. Taele could be kinda passive-aggressive online, he was very chill and understanding in person. If you do the work, this class is an easy A.

Overall the class wasn't bad. However this prof has to have been one of the most rude ones I have come across. Luckily it wasn't to myself directly but some kids just get straight up roasted in class and during their final presentations. Other than that pretty lenient when it comes to absences and grading. Class wasn't hard if u put in the effort.

teacherNote.comment: I do give very blunt feedback, and acknowledge that it comes off as rude. Each team is only given limited time for weekly updates and demos, so I am critical with rushed feedback for missed requirements. My feedback is demanding that can come off dismissive, but I want students properly prepared for upstream courses. I empathize with this concern.

reviews.comment: Very passive-aggressive. Answers things with "refer to rubric". Emailed him once asking a question, and only response was "message me on canvas". There were conflicting messages between his feedback and the rubric, and when brought up, response was:  "I am aware of the rubric, I wrote it." Just very unhelpful which is detrimental in this course.

teacherNote.comment: 1) I responded with "refer to rubric feedback" to trigger Canvas notifications since students were not notified with in-rubric feedback. 2) I tell students to message me on Canvas so their messages do not get lost in my emails. 3) I responded to the student about my awareness of rubric to allow the student to bypass the rubric requirement.

reviews.comment: "refer to rubric"

teacherNote.comment: I wanted to provide context. I do not recall writing "refer to rubric", but I do say "refer to rubric feedback". The reason is that students were not receiving Canvas notifications from in-rubric items feedback, so I wrote this added message to trigger added notifications. I did not mean for this for it to come off as dismissive. Sorry about that.

reviews.comment: CSCE 331 is a time sink in general and will eat up most of your schedule. Dr. Taele's grading also forces you to do every assignment. However, he is one of the most caring professors and allows resubmissions for most assignments. He also tried to get to know his students. The class difficulty mostly depends on how your TA grades.

Unique grading policy where the final grade is based on the lowest category, but it is less intimidating than it initially appears. Students are given many opportunities to revise their work and improve. There are two large group projects, but overall the course workload is manageable.

Was really worried about this class coming in but I feel a lot more confident about my development skills now. A lot of the negatives for this class were required for all instructors. Very lenient on revisions and mostly a chill guy. Would sometimes leave harsh feedback when frustrated or if he felt guidelines were obvious but nothing too serious.

Taele is a great professor who makes an effort to know his students. He's funny and realistic, and is willing to accommodate people. 331 is difficult and time-consuming no matter who the professor is, but he definitely tries his best to help manage it. Lectures were a little unnecessary, but we had lots of group workdays.

An absolute GOAT. Very caring, accessible, and flexible with his students. The course itself have a lot of assignments but Taele grades them very fair and allows make-ups. Overall made 331 a very enjoyable experience despite the general reputation the course has.

The reviews speak for themselves. This class has a writing requirement so a lot of busy work but Dr. Taele helps cut down on a lot of it. Not a lot of teaching in this class, mostly just group work. Super organized course and he is available almost 24/7 outside of class through Discord. Super lenient and funny guy.
Best prof I've ever taken in this or any other department

331 is a workload-heavy course, but Dr. Taele made it much more manageable. He is super responsive to feedback and truly cares about his students. Get a good group and you'll be fine. There will be many assignments beyond the actual project, so be prepared for those. I had an amazing experience with Dr. Taele as the lecturer.

Great guy teaching a terrible course. Imagine your typical software engineering job with a very picky project manager. You need to write a bunch of reports and do useless scrum meetings. However, Taele tries to make it easy on us. He is very lenient on deadlines and there is a very large revision period for assignments.
This class is weird, there aren't really lectures. Taele is more flexible with deadlines than other professors. Friendly guy.

Great guy, easy to talk to, wants to be your friend. Slightly annoying attendance at the first half of the semester but I thought lectures were kinda funny. Gives pretty good feedback and actually grades documents, but only takes off ~0.5/20 per error, just enough to get you to look at the mistake without being too harsh. Great class,wants to teach
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS PROF. GOOD CLASS

Group work can suck, and it did for me. I have never been so stressed from projects before. However, Dr. Taele has mechanisms in place to make sure that you are graded appropriately for your work and so that you don't need to break your back with a carry. Put in the effort, let him know of any problems, and he will take care of you. I will miss him

Taele cares a lot about his students and is great at setting workloads that are reasonable. There is lots of groupwork, but he tries to make class worth our time. He's fun and you will not regret taking him, but the work is rigorous and doesn't ever stop. Stay on top of assignments and you will do great in his class. Definitely take him if you can.

The workload for this course will not be fun regardless of the professor, especially if you get a poor group for the projects. However, Dr. Taele is far and away the greatest professor of the 20+ I have taken here.

Professor Taele is incredible, highly recommend you take his class for 331 if you want an enjoyable experience. The class is tough in terms of workload and assignments, but Professor Taele cares about his students and ensures that there is adequate time to complete things. Overall, great professor!
The class is a lot of work, but I'm convinced Dr. Taele is the nicest man in the world. If I can take more classes with him as the professor, I absolutely will.

The GOAT. Had him for 331/315 and easily best prof. He is so chill and understanding. Pushs deadlines back often to give students more time. He is also pretty funny. Pretty much 3 projects (1 individual + 2 group) do your work on time and contribute to team projects and you're chillin. Highly recommend Taele for any class.

Dr. Taele is the BEST prof in the CSCE dept. All the bad reviews here are judging the class by the difficulty of course content. Dr. Taele is the only CSCE prof that is kind, caring, flexible, and genuinely cares about the class learning the content and performing well. If you attend class, communicate, and earnestly try, you are guaranteed an A.

there are lots of deliverables over the course of the semester but i think that helped keep everyone on track instead of procrastinating. would've preferred more development time rather than spending a month planning but that is something he said he might change. very chill and relaxed which was good for a hectic and stressful class

The professor's teaching lacks clarity and engagement, making lectures tedious. Assignments are vague, offering little guidance. Feedback is minimal, hindering learning. Overall, a disappointing experience that fails to inspire or educate effectively.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 315 isn't necessarily an easy class and it's a lot of work, but Dr. Taele made it as enjoyable as it could be. He cares SO much about his students and really, genuinely wants everyone to learn and thrive in his class. He knew everyone's names by the 2nd week of school. This is one of the only professors I would get myself to campus at 8am for.

Dr. Taele was a great professor. His class was always a pleasure to attend and there was never a dull moment. This class can be time-consuming but with Dr. Taele it doesn't feel impossible. He shows consideration toward the students regarding their time and effort and is very fair with grading and his policies.
This professor conveys content clearly, and is simply the best. He loves his students and will know you by name and will say hi for the semesters after. Great guy, great prof
This class is A LOT of work, however, Taele is the nicest professor I have ever had. He actually goes out of his way to remember every student's name.

I was fortunate to have completed a three-lap course with Professor Taele for 121, 315, and 482. He truly is the GOAT professor in the department. From what seemed to be a gamble in his first CSCE 121 class, I'm glad I took that chance. Thanks for taking a chance on my capstone idea

Homework will help, but make sure to do reviews. He is difficult to understand and not clear on explaining some topics. I read and did examples in the book and still was confused. The final is extremely difficult. Make sure to study and do reviews and extra practice.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is hard, especially if you don't have experience with C++. However Taele goes above and beyond to help students. His office hours were packed with students from other classes and he is always trying to help you. The best prof for 120/121. Highly recommend, he's the goat.

Dr. Taele refuses to simplify any concepts to aid in understanding during lecture, his lecture slides are undecipherable unless you rewatch entire lectures, and you receive NO feedback on any assignment or exam. His courses are harder than any other professor for no reason other than him, take anyone else available
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The due dates and assignments were not clear and it was difficult to gain help from him. I would recommend a different teacher.
Taele is an amazing dude, the 30 other 5 star reviews will tell you the same. one caveat is that he sometimes smells funky.. not sure if its laundry or hygiene but it can be quite noticeable

Being able to find helpful advice was quite difficult and I don't think I got a conductive learning environment. I would suggest other professors who can create a better learning environment for students.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Taele is a great professor. CSCE 121 is a hard class if you are new to computer science, but he makes the material easy to understand and helps his students as much as he is allowed to.

Probably not teaching 121 next anymore, but I wanted to inflate his RMP score even more because he deserves it. Not only hilarious and informative during lectures, but super caring and active in helping students -- always answering emails, Piazza, officer hours, PT central, etc. He's really set the bar for profs for me, truly the GOAT.
Probably one of the best professor. The professor is a fun person to be around. Do the homework and labs. For the test, do actual coding not just looking at the slides to learn how to actually code.

I don't think Taele will be teaching more 121 in the future, which is really a shame. He made the 8am lectures really fun and engaging (genuinely made me want to get up and walk to Zach for it)! Saved my auto admit into comp sci rounding my 89.7, a real homie for that. Overall great prof, funny and super caring. 10/10 recommend!

Dr. Taele gives fun and insightful lectures that make waking up at 8 am worth it. They provide a more "hands-on" approach to teaching c++ which helps when exams come around. While Dr. Taele does not have the most extensive background in c++ as other professors currently, I would still recommend taking them.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For the awful reputation that 121 gets, Dr. Taele really makes this class easy. Show up to class, take notes, and use office hours when you can; Dr. Taele is very caring and will help you reach your goals. Also, the lectures were the best I've had at TAMU.

Taele is the GOAT. CSCE 121 is a really difficult class (Homeworks take anywhere from 3-12 hours), but Taele makes this class bearable and fun. I didn't go to his office hours, but emailed him frequently and he answered all my questions and even manually checked my code once to help me find an issue. This guy is truly the best option.
All My Jits Rock With Taele No Cap
ALL MY HOMIES LOVE TAELE!!!!

This class is very difficult and takes up a lot of time. The homework will take anywhere from 3-15 hours. If you go to his office hours and show that you are putting in the work he will make sure you do good. After tests go to him and talk about the grading and rubric he will give points back if he feels it is deserved. Hard course AMAZING prof.

Dr. Taele is a good professor and a greater human being. He changed my view on professors as a whole at Texas A&M and does a lot for his students. He has a humble and caring persona, and talking with him felt like talking with another student. Although 121 has annoyingly long homeworks and doesn't feel like an intro course, Taele can make it easier

I didn't find office hours very helpful nor were the expectations of the class well defined. I wish I had received more help from the professor outside of class even after making an attempt to learn. I'd recommend a different professor for this course who is more helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Taele was by far my favorite TAMU professor. He always uploads his slides and is very accessible outside of class. This is a guy who would stay up with us during his office hours until everyone left. Sometimes this meant till midnight. It's a tough class if it's your first experience coding. Go to office hours, ask questions, and you'll do great.

I took Dr. Taele for 121, and now for 315, he is still wonderful as always. Dr. Taele is always receptive to student concerns and feedback and is overall a really caring and approachable professor. There is a bit of busy work within the class but it is very do-able. Highly recommend him for both 121 and 315. Dr. Taele the homie frfr.

Prof. Taele is one of the greatest CS professors! He is very dedicated to his classes and will make sure students get the help they need. He is truly such a gem at TAMU and always makes sure the students will get the benefit of the doubt. I'm very sure I wouldn't have gotten an A if it weren't for Prof. Taele and the numerous hours I've spent in oh
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Taele is the only professor you should take for 121. If you have the ability to take him do it. Even if it's at 8 am. Best professor I've ever had. Go to his office hours and just talk to him. He's an amazing guy, super caring about his students and his class. TAKE HIM!

The CSCE121 class could be better as a whole. The class is run by 5 professors, 3 of which kind of suck (they are incapable of empathy). But, Paul is the one who understands that it is supposed to be an *introductory* programming class. He is very caring and will go out of his way to make sure you understand the material. Take him if you can!

Professor Taele is very different than any other professor for 121. It's a godawful class and he's aware of that, and if you're willing to ask for his help? He will do anything he can to help you. His slides are always uploaded, and he is one of the few professors that I chose to go to in person lecture for.

Honestly, the homework is absolutely awful, but none of the material is on the exams. If you REALLY study past exam and his study guide/exam review a few days before the exam, you should be good. Really do not like Mr. Taele, he constantly makes you feel inferior and not important
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You must go to class to pass this course. paul does not upload any of his "slides" because he just writes on the whiteboard in class. Tests should be easy, but he puts trick questions on them. He is a knowledgeable guy, but he did not know how to teach the material well at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Taele is easily the best professor in the computer science department. His lectures are actually fun to attend and you will actually learn the material. That being said, 121 is a relatively intensive class and there is quite a bit of extra work. You will have to work really hard, but Professor Taele works equally hard to ease your burden.

Taele has been my favorite prof so far. He wants you to succeed and he is very nice. His lectures explain the content well and prepare you well for the assignments. CSCE121 prompts can be daunting and sometimes hard to understand, but Taele will make the daunting and time-consuming assignments a lot easier.

This professor is an absolute legend. He would stay outside of office hours to help me for several hours afterwards even when I explained it was not necessary. Lectures absolute carried lots of students. He was very kind and down to earth, and took notes about his students in office hours to better help them in the future. I wish him the best.

The class itself takes a ridiculous amount of time and effort, but Prof. Taele makes it bearable. He's a competent lecturer and makes those 8 AMs much more bearable with humor and enthusiasm. The class itself is managed by multiple professors, so there's not too much else to say specifically about Taele.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Taele is the best choice for CSCE121. He gave important hw hints/tips every week and his lectures have examples that help w the lab and hw. Helps ALOT in office hrs. 121 is a class w pretty heavy homework each week, so you will need a prof that helps a ton. His difficulty level is only bc of the difficulty of the class, not bc Taele is difficult.

Dr. Taele is one of the if not the best professor for CSCE 121. I went in with zero C++ knowledge and still did great. He is like your friend and will tell you like a friend what is needed to be done. He genuinely care for his students. This is a hard course, so you have to earn whatever grade you going to get. Overall, I loved his class.

CSCE 121 is a very tough 100-level class, but Dr. Taele makes it well worth the struggle. He cares about all the students in the class and will help you in any situation. He makes his lectures enjoyable to attend. Weekly homework can be cumbersome but it's doable. If you have the opportunity definitely go with Dr. Taele.

Dr. Taele is the G.O.A.T. (and I don't use that term with just anyone). He's done a great job at fostering a relaxing and fun learning environment, even though I took the class at 8 AM. Also I met him in a Starbucks once and he is such a nice guy, we had a conversation about why C++ is a lame coding language (even though that's what he teaches).

Genuinely a great professor. His lectures are easy to understand and clear. Homework for the class is common throughout all sections, but he does his best to explain them. Looks like someone is review bombing the page judging by how similar they're written. The stuff written there is just wrong, he's really nice and good with questions.

Not sure why someone is making multiple accounts to leave Taele bad reviews, but I wouldn't listen to them. You will be lucky to have him as your CSCE 121 prof. He's super caring and genuinely wants you to succeed. His ppts lecture are informative and often better than other instructors. Weekly HWs so start early! Take him if you have the chance!!!

The people who say he is rude or disrespectful have absolutely no sense of humor. He is a very nice guy and jokes around with students, which I find more valuable than just reciting material. His lecture slides are better than other professors since he provides useful examples for the homework. If you put in the work, it is very easy to succeed.

Dr. Taele is both funny and caring towards his students. He cares a lot about making sure his students understand the material. He focuses not only on teaching the conceptual material, but also makes sure students have plenty practical examples to do well on homeworks which are a big part of your grade and time in this class. Highly recommend him!

Great professor who truly cares about his students. He will always take the time to help you out and explain anything you don't understand. Lectures are informative and no question is a bad question. High energy guy with a passion for computer science. Weekly homework, but that's the only way to learn how to code. About 6-10 hours a week of coding.

CSCE121 has weekly homework and lab work you cannot avoid, regardless of which professor you have, but Prof Taele is very helpful during lectures and office hours. He is one of the younger profs and Is more lenient and there are rarely any complaints on him. Would definitely recommend him

Dr. Taele truly cares about his students. Almost any of his students can vouch for how much he cares about his students and their well-being. He would hold review sessions for exams and provide useful advice for assignments. He was overall just a really cool guy. I would love to take another class from him in the future. GGS.

CSCE 121 has standard tests and labs, so it generally doesn't matter what professor you get, but Prof Taele is a great and fun guy. His lectures aren't the best, but he is willing to help outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A believe Dr. Taele is the best professor for 121. If you come up to him after class/lab/office hours he is always more than willing to help as much as he can. He responds very quickly to emails and piazza you can tell he actually cares. There were many complaints about the other professors in the group chat but never about Taele.

Dr. Taele is one of the best 121 profs. Very active and helpful on piazza. Makes jokes and is a general fun guy. The class is quite difficult because of the weekly homeworks, but Taele answers all questions.

Coding homework every week is somewhat time consuming, but you are given plenty of help and time to do it. Lab is weekly and the difficulty depends on your TA. I'm comfortable with coding courses and found this one to be par for the course, but started off quickly.
